notes.title: The world of Sky Escort will officially hit the shelves on June 20!
notes.notes:
Dartmasters, welcome to the world of Sky Dart!

The official version of the game will officially hit the shelves on June 20, repel the strong enemies in the sky in a journey full of challenges, and become the greatest captain in the dome of the sky!

In the official version of the game to be launched tomorrow, we will bring 3 camps, more than 100 kinds of airship accessories and nearly 300 kinds of cards, free combination of hundreds of tactics, to meet the unknown adventure!

[b]Styles of Battle[/b]
The Empire's armored ships and artillery, the Panda Immortal's yin and yang, and the Wanderer's sound waves and chords, make full use of the characteristics of each camp in the three factions to cope with wave after wave of attacks!


[b]Building Cards of Various Shapes[/b]
Giant cannons, crossbow towers, tanks, from ancient machine technology to futuristic laser lasers, use dozens of different fortifications to defend your ship, use work and construction to enrich resources and supplies, 250+ cards waiting to be unlocked by all the dartmasters, and flexibly construct your own deck to defend your ship!


[b]Build your own strongest warship[/b].
Wings, sails, propellers ...... How can the vast skies be spiced up with warships? Utilize more than 100 different kinds of accessories to build the strongest warship and seize the first opportunity in the battle! Recruit sailors with different abilities at the academy and upgrade buildings and cards at the dockyard to build the strongest team!


[b]Challenging Sky Fighter[/b]
The ferocious cat 'sea' pirates, the giant dragons perched in the sky and the unnameable ancient gods, three bosses in different forms lead their vicious troops one after another, use your cards flexibly to face different powerful enemies!


Once again, we welcome all players to this crisis-ridden airspace!
We will also continue to update new cards, enemies and camps to bring you a richer gaming experience.
Dart players who have suggestions and feedback on the game can join the [u]official community: 798831969[/u]

notes.title: 天行镖客——【世界线】漫展归来回顾
notes.notes:
Hello大家好，好久不见~不知道这个五一大家是出去旅游了还是在家里打游戏呢？

我们五一节带着《天行镖客》全新不同的版本，在成都[世界线]展会参展~

不知道参加展会的朋友有没有在现场抓到我们呢？

现场玩家的热情也是非常高~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340628/518cf677c1a0855984dc786021e2cfbabd186411.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340628/fedad02147a539d93e5d05337594565ba0a5da8a.jpg[/img]

当然现场除了coser和游戏试玩之外也还有很多非常有意思的活动。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340628/0416dd5bf358f0bd0ad294f72905d8ebfe5515d1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340628/afcf7fcc893da2025f62b060d9214052a39f3977.jpg[/img]

很久没出来冒泡，大家可能都以为我们停止更新了，其实我们自从推出抢鲜体验后，并未停止更新，我们一直在持续对游戏调整和优化，并推出了超多全新卡牌和超多改动，即将上线大家敬请期待~

最后，除了展会回顾之外，这次我们也给大家带来了一些福利！

欢迎大家添加我们的官方社群：798831969  吹水聊天等你来~

notes.title: [Sky ESCORT] Game Trial Tasting Event Participation Decision
notes.notes:
Brothers, it's been a long time, we decided that we will participate in the game demo tasting party organized by Yu Cha Club and Chengdu Worldline Comic Con during the 5.1 holiday~.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340628/dac9b78eba7e066eb77168170f631e9064a77144.png[/img]

At that time, you can play the brand new version of Sky Dart (we have made significant adjustments to the card system), to feel the real-time card roguelike gameplay, and your valuable comments are very important to us, after the trial game we also look forward to the feedback you leave, with which the game continues to be polished and improved!


Lastly, I would like to thank everyone for supporting our game, and I would also like to let you know that we have actually been tweaking and optimizing the game and will be announcing a brand new version soon.

notes.title: Update on 2024.2.25
notes.notes:
1.Optimized English text.
2.There is a chance for orange cards to appear in the shop.

Bug Fixes:
1. Military Power Core +: Inconsistency between description and effect.
2. All-Out Attack +: Inconsistency between description and effect.

notes.title: Update on 2024.2.22
notes.notes:
System:
1. Added new player tutorial.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when recruiting sailor agents with insufficient card quantity.
2. Optimized enemy attacks ignoring guards and targeting other positions.

notes.title: 2024.2.21 Update
notes.notes:
Cards:
1. Empty City: Now stops all weapons from attacking on the field for 15 seconds. Afterward, deals 20 (30) damage to all enemies on the field.
2. CleanUp: Now gains 5 (7) supply for every card in the draw pile.
3. Advance: Cost reduced from 20 to 15.

Optimizations:
1. When hovering over a weapon with the mouse, it now accurately displays the weapon's current attack power and maximum health.
2. Added more selectable game resolutions.
3. Card packs from level completion rewards will no longer contain duplicate cards.
4. There is now a chance for orange or blue cards to appear in card packs from level completion rewards.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed the bug where enemies would sometimes ram the deck twice.
2. Fixed the bug where the game resolution was incorrect on some laptops.
3. Fixed the issue with the incorrect effect of the Sound Mixer +.
4. Fixed the discrepancy between the effect and description of the Yin and Yang Harmony card.

notes.title: Update on February 19
notes.notes:
Cards:
1. The cost of "Sowing Beans into Soldiers" has been adjusted from 80 to 90.
2. Fixed the issue where upgrading the Butcher Chainsaw Cannon had no effect.

Optimizations:
1. When players choose to return to the city without claiming a reward, they will be prompted again that there are unredeemed rewards.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed a bug where players could not click on buildings when the Candle Dragon Boss used "Polar Night's Descent."

notes.title: February 18 Updates
notes.notes:
Card Changes:
1. Rock You card description error, should be "Lasts 45 seconds" instead of "Lasts 60 seconds".
2. Human Resources +: Change to -> Cost; Gain +80 supplies and remove 2 cards from the current battle.
3. Sonic Cannon: Change to -> Deals 50(75) damage to designated enemy. If the enemy is killed, gain +1 Sonic.
4. Bribery: Change to -> Deals 150%(200%) supply production damage to enemies in range.

Attachments:
1. Blaze: Change to -> Draw one additional card in the first 30/45/60 seconds.

Sailors:
1. SCV: Change to -> Gain 5 supplies after completing each task.
2. Treasure: Change to -> When your supply count reaches 0, immediately gain one random supply.

Shop:
1. Increase starting price for sailor refresh from 100 to 200.

System:
1. Damaged decks do not damage the ship when attacked.
2. Non-weapon structures on the deck will be damaged when attacked but will not damage the ship.
3. Optimized display of sailor list and card list.

Bug Fixes:
1. Incorrect display of pause icon.
2. BUG where the city functionality did not refresh after exiting the reward claim interface.
3. Incorrect prompt when repairing the workshop with full ship health.
4. BUG where the Sailor's Craftsman effect was not working.
